x: Sprinter Melissa Bentt, middle-distance runners Laura Wilson and Angela Hearn, and thrower Michelle Stock are all first year under-17s yet in the Southern Women's League they have to compete as Seniors.
In the middle-distance events it was Angela Hearn's first ever attempt at 3000 metres. She had a good run and it was some time before our 'A' runner Nina Mills got past her.

We only had three winners in the whole meeting - all in 'B' events; fifteen year-old Angela Hearn put up with the severe heat to win the senior 3000 metres, Jacqui Smiter in the triple jump and Janine Brown in the U15G javelin.

We were still a bit short of athletes but when you've got girls like Debbie and Angela Hearn turning up when they should have been enjoying the last day of their holidays then you know you've got good team spirit.
Angela Hearn has been a regular in 3k track races and has even competed over 10k on the road. Andrea Abrams continues to dominate our long jump lists and had a best this year of 5.49m.

With Michelle Stock cracking 30 metres for the first time in the discus and creeping to within reach of Cindy James' Club Record and Angela Hearn running off with the 3000m we can feel proud that not only is our overall strength spreading over track and field, it is also not just confined to the boy's events.
